data.name: Anvar
data.gender_notes: Anvar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word anwar, meaning 'bright' or 'radiant'. In Islamic context, Anvar can be interpreted as a bearer of light or a guide. In the Quran, Allah (swt) says: 'Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth.' (Surah An-Nur, 24:35). The name Anvar carries the meaning “Light, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Anvar usually hope their child will grow to embody light, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Anvar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light, Radiant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anvar total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
